sceneBoundaryChanged: This scene's outside boundary changed. Its draft remains intact in the full manuscript; switch to Full manuscript to review it without guessing scene membership.
outlineConflictReviewNotice: The shared structure changed. This draft keeps base version {{version}} and will not overwrite the current metadata. Review the current shared fields and explicitly choose which draft values to merge, or keep/download this private draft.
reviewOutline: Read current outline for reviewed merge
outlineMergeInstructions: Compare your original base, current shared version {{version}}, and private draft. Choose each field explicitly. Saving writes only chosen draft fields with this reviewed version as the CAS base.
outlineIdentityChanged: This scene or lane identity is missing or changed. Its draft field cannot be applied to a different source.
outlineReviewStale: The outline or draft changed after review. Read and review the current fields again.
